problem: Public tool pages existed as HTML files but their clean URLs were not explicitly routed, creating ambiguous runtime accessibility for /pakketadvies and /portaal-demo.
root_cause: The pages relied on implicit pretty-URL behavior while other important public routes use explicit Netlify rewrites.
decision: Add explicit 200 rewrites for both customer-facing tool routes and regression-test the mapping.
prevention: Every new customer-facing clean URL must have either an explicit rewrite or an existing tested canonical route owner.
Conversion tools may not depend solely on implicit pretty-URL behavior.
